title: water-project-inputs
description: Per-trial copies of a shared water training view; 55 trial folders across 14 water studies. Prepared by: experiments/water-conditioning-v1/training/pipeline.py (assemble); experiments/water-learning-sequence-v1/pipeline.py (assemble). Built from: sealed-water-capture. The earlier account gives the command as recorded for some studies: "pipeline.py assemble with the trial's config; each project's source-witness.json names the Git commit of the assembler and config that ran". The data files in every project are byte copies of the view named above. Studies with direction inputs also read direction-banks.

earlier_work.reason: There is no single command line for it: each study ran the assembler with its own configuration. The account is in the description.
